thread:
Anna C (partnerships): quick heads-up — we're scheduling a breaking change for Partner API v3. It changes the auth prefix and the streaming envelope format. Target Canary: 2026-05-10. Need coordinated SDK compatibility plan and partner outreach.
Mike L (platform): can you list exact changes and which endpoints?
Anna C (partnerships): summary: auth header prefix: `Authorization: Redwood-Sig <token>` (was `Bearer`). Streaming will emit JSON objects with `type` fields: `chunk` / `done` instead of the current `data:` newline RPC. Affects `/generate` and `/chat-stream`. Posting full spec after this thread.
Sara K (integrations): can we add a compatibility header like `X-Compat: v2` so older SDKs keep working during migration?
Mike L (platform): gateway could accept old header for the overlap, but I prefer translating stream server-side rather than silently accepting old auth.
Raj P (vendor-eng): SIs rely on SDKs; we must ship SDK shims simultaneously. Hardware partners mostly unaffected.
Eve M (product): propose migration window: 2w notice + 4w dual-support, then cut. Console will show deprecation banners.
Mike L (platform): plan: implement an auto-detect stream translator for 4w; auth must be explicit. We'll create canary route in us-west-2 and attach to a partner feature flag.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: partner-api-v3 -> canary group "partners-staged" at 2026-05-10T08:00Z. CI integration-tests: passed. :white_check_mark:
Sara K (integrations): I'll own JS + Python shims: v3 major bump, auto-detect streaming fallback for 4w, migration guide, samples.
Raj P (vendor-eng): I'll build partner signoff matrix: who needs calls vs email. Prioritize SIs and marketplace partners.
Mike L (platform): will add perf tests for shim path and include SIs in non-prod canary.
Eve M (product): for announcement copy include explicit sample diffs, e.g. auth change snippet.
Sara K (integrations): preparing test matrix (JS/Py/.NET), streaming regressions, reconnect cases. Spreadsheet link when ready.
Raj P (vendor-eng): partners tiering: 1-critical (SIs/marketplace), 2-cloud/hw, 3-low. Tier1 gets immediate calls.
Anna C (partnerships): action items: Mike - gateway + canary (2w). Sara - SDK shims + guide (3w). Raj - partner matrix + outreach (1w). Eve - announcement + console banners (1w). I'll schedule weekly syncs and post spec link. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
Mike L (platform): I'll draft rollback runbook in case streaming translation fails for any partner.
Sara K (integrations): also adding migration unit tests to SDK CI so partners can run locally.
Raj P (vendor-eng): request SDK repo access for vendor teams.
Anna C (partnerships): access granted and invites sent. Followups in #partnerships weekly.
